infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PlayPark uses your location to show nearby playgrounds and let friends see which park you're at.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: PlayPark uses your location in the background to automatically check you in when you arrive at a playground.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PlayPark uses your location to show nearby playgrounds and optionally auto-detect arrivals.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PlayPark uses your camera to scan QR codes when adding parent friends.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PlayPark accesses your photos so you can add a profile picture for you and your children.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow PlayPark to use your location to find nearby playgrounds.
